_comment: Track C movement tunables. Units: tiles (2.5 ft), seconds. See docs/tracks/movement.md and docs/tracks/pace.md for the reasoning.

pace._comment: THE pace knob: tiles a second a walk-30 body runs. Every horizontal and movement-mode speed below is a share of it (speed: x pace, scaled again by the body's SRD speed / 30 ft), and every acceleration is the time (s) to reach it, so this one number retunes the player, monsters and people together. 2.0 is SRD real time (30 ft per 6 s round). 4.0 is the SRD Dash in real time (60 ft a round) and what the game ships with (docs/tracks/pace.md). The game ran 13.0 before 2026-11-08. Jumps do not scale (height and time to apex stay), so they clear the same obstacles at any pace; what a pace changes is how far a running jump carries.

sizes._comment: Collision box per SRD size: w x h in tiles (multiples of 1/8 so contact positions are exact in float32); step = tiles of automatic step-up.

run._comment: speed: x pace. *_s: seconds from a standstill to pace (accel), from pace to a stop (friction), and from pace one way to a stop on turning (turn); air_*: the same in the air.

drop._comment: S (down) alone drops through a one-way floor once held this long (s) from a press made while standing; a brush of S shorter than this does nothing. Down + jump still drops at once.

rope._comment: Tiles a rope unrolls at most from its anchor (core/world/rope.gd); climbed with the ladder numbers.

ladder._comment: x pace, the same for every body (anyone can use a ladder or rope; a climb speed raises it). 0.75: a 30-tile rope takes 10 s at pace 4.

climb._comment: Wall climbing with an SRD climb speed: speed x pace per 30 ft of climb.

swim._comment: speed: x pace per 30 ft of swim speed (no swim speed: half the walk, the SRD's costs double). accel_s: seconds to swim speed at pace. gravity, buoyancy, drag, max_sink, brake are water physics and do not scale.

fly._comment: speed: x pace per 30 ft of fly speed; accel_s: seconds to pace.

burrow._comment: speed: x pace per 30 ft of burrow speed.
